fullDescription: Premium enterprise-grade cybersecurity SaaS style guide featuring a high-contrast dark mode aesthetic. Utilizing a dark navy and charcoal foundation (#0a0e27) with technical accents of emerald, cyan, and amber. The design employs editorial typography (Clash Grotesk and Satoshi), glassmorphism effects, and a rigid grid-based layout. Optimized for high-trust industries like fintech, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and enterprise infrastructure platforms. Key elements include scroll-triggered animations, bento-grid analytics dashboards, and glowing primary CTAs.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated, dark-themed enterprise SaaS design system that balances technical precision with high-end editorial polish. It uses subtle noise textures, grid-based backgrounds, and frosted-glass components to create depth and credibility.

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual style based on a 'Dark Intelligence' theme. Background: solid #0a0e27 with a 48px grid overlay in rgba(148,163,184,0.08) and a subtle 22% opacity noise texture. Typography: Headings in 'Clash Grotesk' (Semibold, tracking-tight), Body in 'Satoshi' (Regular for text, Bold for emphasis). Color Palette: Foundation #0a0e27; Accents: Emerald (#34d399), Cyan (#22d3ee), Amber (#fbbf24), Red (#f87171). Component styling: Use glassmorphism with 'backdrop-blur-xl', 'bg-white/5', and 'border-white/10'. Shadows should be deep and soft (e.g., shadow-black/40). Buttons: Primary buttons should be #34d399 with a glow effect (shadow-emerald-400/30), Secondary buttons are transparent with white/12 border. Hover states: 200-300ms transitions, -4px Y-axis translation, and increased border brightness.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Design a sticky navigation bar with a glassmorphism background (#0b1028 at 80% opacity, backdrop-blur-md). Left: Logo with a shield icon in #34d399. Center: 6 text links in Satoshi Medium, 14px, #cbd5e1. Right: 'Login' secondary button and 'Start Free Scan' primary button in Emerald #34d399. Border-bottom: 1px solid white/10.

### Hero Section
A two-column grid layout (0.9fr 1.1fr). Left column: An AI-native badge (Emerald background at 10% opacity), H1 'Clash Grotesk' 72px heading, 20px body text, and a dual-button CTA group. Below CTAs, a 3-column stats row with 1px white/10 borders. Right column: A floating dashboard mockup with complex UI elements (risk charts, status indicators, and a scan progress bar) animated with a 7s translateY float effect.

### Trusted By Logo Cloud
Full-width section with a subtle #ffffff06 background. Centered title in all-caps, 14px, 0.24em tracking. Grid of 8 grayscale logos, each inside a rounded-2xl container with white/8 borders. Hover effect: Transition from grayscale(100%) to grayscale(0%) and increase brightness.

### Feature Grid
8-card bento grid (2 columns on tablet, 4 on desktop). Cards use bg-white/5, 24px border-radius, and 1px white/10 border. Each card features a 32px Lucide-style icon in accent colors (Emerald/Cyan/Amber), an H3 heading, and a 14px description. Hover state: Card lifts 8px and border changes to accent color with a subtle outer glow.

### Security Analytics Dashboard Preview
A large-scale dashboard visualization within a 2rem rounded container. Features a 3-column sub-grid: Column 1: Vertical bar chart showing 'Vulnerability Trends'. Column 2: Large radial gauge showing 'Security Score' (81/100) and a risk heatmap. Column 3: 'Active Threats' feed with color-coded status pills (Red/Amber/Cyan).

### Workflow Timeline
Three-step horizontal workflow. Each step has a 64px icon in a colored container. A 1px dashed or gradient line connects the steps. Use bg-white/5 for step containers. Typography: H3 title and 16px muted description.

### Pricing Tiers
Three vertical cards. The center 'Professional' or 'Enterprise' card should have a 35% opacity Emerald border and a 'Recommended' badge. Pricing text in 48px Clash Grotesk. Feature list items prefixed with a checkmark. Buttons: Secondary style for base tiers, Primary Emerald for the featured tier.

### FAQ Accordion
Max-width 896px centered container. Accordion items with 16px spacing. Each item: bg-white/5, 16px padding, Lucide 'plus' icon that rotates 45 degrees on open. Smooth height transition for the answer text.

### Footer
Multi-column layout (5 columns: Brand, Product, Company, Resources, Legal). Darker background than main (#080d22). Social icons in circular white/10 borders. Copyright and contact info in a bottom row separated by a 1px white/10 border.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Live Scan Progress Bar — An animated progress bar simulating a security scan.
A 8px height container with bg-white/8. Inside, a gradient bar (Emerald to Cyan to Red) that animates its width from 18% to 92% using a cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) over 5.5s, alternating indefinitely.

### CVSS Risk Gauge — A circular data visualization for threat scores.
A 112px circle with a conic-gradient background (e.g., Red 72%, White/8 72%). Centered within it is a smaller 80px solid #080d22 circle containing a large white font-bold number (e.g., '9.1').

### Glass-morphic Threat Feed — A list of real-time alerts with pulsing status indicators.
Vertical stack of containers with 10% opacity colored backgrounds (Red/Amber/Cyan). Each contains a 10px dot that pulses in opacity (feed-pulse animation: 0.72 to 1.0 opacity over 2.8s) and small 12px technical text.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Dark Intelligence' aesthetic. Typography pairings use 'Clash Grotesk' for high-impact display headings and 'Satoshi' for clean, readable body text. The color palette is anchored in deep navy (#0a0e27), utilizing semi-transparent white borders (10-12% opacity) for glassmorphism. Accent colors are functional: Emerald (#34d399) for success, Cyan (#22d3ee) for information, Amber (#fbbf24) for warnings, and Red (#f87171) for critical alerts. Animations are smooth and physics-based, featuring slow floating (7s), rhythmic pulsing, and linear scanning progress indicators.
